name: brand_analytics_growth_machine_diagnosis
description:
Fuses Search Query Performance (SQP) + Search Catalog Performance (SCP) + Amazon Ads (PPC) at the (keyword × ASIN × period) grain and emits one locked prescription per row. This is THE core tool for executing the 'Growth Machine' playbook (SQP tells you where demand is, SCP tells you why you do/don't convert it, PPC tells you what happens when you pay for it).

Prescription enum (one of):
- FIX_CART_LEAK_CUT_PPC   — cart_to_purchase_rate < threshold AND PPC spend ≥ min → plug final-mile leak BEFORE scaling ads.
- NEGATIVE_EXACT          — PPC sales = 0 on ≥ ppc_clicks_min clicks → bleeder, negative-exact and remove from backend.
- INJECT_INTO_SEO         — PPC CVR ≥ green threshold AND organic brand_purchase_share < red threshold → proven winner invisible organically; move into Title/Bullets.
- DEFEND_ORGANIC          — Organic brand_purchase_share ≥ green (cannibalization or defend). Cut PPC bid or hold defensive ad support.
- DISPLACE_WEAK_LEADER    — Top-1 competitor converts < red threshold AND we are already close → allocate budget to displace.
- EVALUATE_OR_SKIP        — No clear signal; gather more data or deprioritize.

PPC SOURCE: Amazon Ads Marketing Stream in Athena (amazon_ads.ads_dataset), Sponsored Products EXACT-match keyword targets only, aggregated to (keyword × advertised ASIN) over the same SQP weeks and converted to USD. EXACT is the only match type whose keyword equals the shopper's search term, so it is the only one that can join SQP. BROAD/PHRASE/auto/ASIN/category targets cannot be attributed to a search term and are excluded. Rows without an EXACT target have ppc_evaluated=false, NULL ppc_* metrics and NULL (not false) PPC-driven signals (sig_cart_leak, sig_bleeder, sig_proven_winner, sig_cannibalization) — read NULL as 'not evaluated', never as 'no spend'. For those rows FIX_CART_LEAK_CUT_PPC / NEGATIVE_EXACT / INJECT_INTO_SEO cannot fire and DEFEND_ORGANIC comes from the organic share signal alone. The header reports ppc_source_status ('ok' | 'no_ad_data' | 'error'), ppc_total_sp_spend_usd, ppc_exact_spend_usd, ppc_exact_spend_coverage_pct (share of SP spend the EXACT leg represents), normalization_match_rate, ppc_attributed_rows and warnings[]. Always relay the warnings and coverage to the user.

ORGANIC SHARE: sqp_brand_purchase_share is the ASIN's share of the query's purchases (Amazon asin_purchase_share, 0-100 scale; thresholds are fractions, compared after /100). sqp_market_purchase_rate is the market conversion rate (total_purchase_rate) — before 2026-11-13 sqp_brand_purchase_share wrongly carried that market rate. When there is no SQP row for the keyword × ASIN (sqp_data_available=false, typically a PPC-only keyword) or Amazon left the share blank, organic share is unknown and sig_proven_winner, sig_cannibalization and sig_defend are NULL, so INJECT_INTO_SEO / DEFEND_ORGANIC cannot fire for that row.

All thresholds come from etl.ba_ryg_thresholds_current with tool IN ('growth_machine','sqp','scp','global') and per-company override precedence.

When `use_tracked_search_terms=true` (default), the keyword universe is auto-scoped to rows in analytics.ba_tracked_search_terms. When `use_competitor_registry=true` (default), competitor_asins are exposed for keywords they share. When screenshot data exists in sqp_query_details_uploads for a (keyword, period), `screenshot_data_available=true` and leader/my_share_gap signals are enriched; otherwise leader-based prescriptions are best-effort from SCP market-share approximations.

Each row includes `seller_central_query_detail_url` — a deep link the user can open in Seller Central to upload a screenshot via brand_analytics_upload_sqp_query_details when screenshot_data_available=false.

`normalization_match_rate` is the share of in-scope PPC EXACT keywords that matched an SQP keyword after LOWER(TRIM(...)) normalization, so the agent can reason about drift. `keywords_in_scope` counts distinct keywords on the returned page (after `limit`), not the full scope.

entity_ids.description: Optional. ASINs (for child_asin/parent_asin), family names (product_family), or brand names (brand). Empty array = all company catalog.

keywords.description: Optional explicit keyword filter. Overrides use_tracked_search_terms when non-empty.

intent_ids.description: Optional: restrict diagnosis to keywords mapped to any of these user-intent-cluster ids (search_term_to_intent table). Intersected (AND) with the keyword scope: if `keywords` or tracked terms are present, results must be in BOTH sets; if only `intent_ids` is supplied, intent terms become the scope. Get available intent_ids from brand_analytics_list_user_intent_clusters.

group_by.description:
Optional dimensions to aggregate results (max 3). When provided, returns grouped rows in `aggregations` instead of per-row `items`.

Output columns by dimension:
- 'intent' → intent_id, intent_label
- 'prescription' → prescription
- 'product_family' → product_family
- 'brand' → brand
- 'parent_asin' → parent_asin

All grouped rows also include: row_count, keyword_count, asin_count; prescription distribution (n_fix_cart_leak, n_negative_exact, n_inject_into_seo, n_defend_organic, n_displace_weak_leader, n_evaluate_or_skip); signal counts (n_sig_cart_leak, n_sig_bleeder, n_sig_proven_winner, n_sig_cannibalization, n_sig_weak_leader, n_sig_defend); averaged KPIs (avg_sqp_impression_share, avg_sqp_click_share, avg_sqp_brand_purchase_share, avg_sqp_market_purchase_rate, avg_ppc_cvr, avg_ppc_roas, avg_cart_to_purchase_rate); summed PPC metrics over PPC-evaluated rows (total_ppc_spend, total_ppc_sales, total_ppc_clicks; NULL when none) and n_ppc_evaluated. Note: SCP search traffic sales are intentionally excluded from grouped output — SCP is ASIN-grain with no query dimension, so it cannot be meaningfully distributed across intent or prescription buckets.

normalization_match_rate.description: Share of in-scope SP EXACT keywords that also appear in SQP. NULL when there is no PPC data.

ppc_source_status.description: 'ok' = Athena returned SP data; 'no_ad_data' = no SP spend in the window; 'error' = Athena failed (all PPC signals NULL).

ppc_total_sp_spend_usd.description: Total Sponsored Products spend (USD) for the company/marketplace/period, all match types.

ppc_exact_spend_usd.description: SP spend (USD) on EXACT keyword targets, before the entity/keyword scope.

ppc_exact_spend_coverage_pct.description: ppc_exact_spend_usd / ppc_total_sp_spend_usd x 100: how much of the SP spend the PPC signals can see.

ppc_rows_truncated.description: True when more than 5000 EXACT keyword x ASIN pairs existed and only the top 5000 by spend were used.

ppc_attributed_rows.description: Rows on this page with ppc_evaluated=true (ungrouped mode).

warnings.description: Caveats about the PPC leg; relay them to the user.

group_by.description: Echoes the requested grouping dimensions (only present in grouped mode).

aggregations.description: Present when `group_by` is non-empty. Each row is a grouped prescription summary bucket with counts, averaged KPIs, and summed spend/sales.

row_count.description: Number of (keyword × ASIN) rows in this bucket.

avg_sqp_brand_purchase_share.description: Mean ASIN purchase share (0-100) over rows with SQP data.

avg_sqp_market_purchase_rate.description: Mean market conversion rate (total_purchase_rate) over rows with SQP data.

total_ppc_spend.description: Summed over rows with an EXACT target; NULL when no row in the bucket was PPC-evaluated.

total_ppc_sales.description: Summed over rows with an EXACT target; NULL when no row in the bucket was PPC-evaluated.

total_ppc_clicks.description: Summed over rows with an EXACT target; NULL when no row in the bucket was PPC-evaluated.

n_ppc_evaluated.description: Rows in this bucket with an SP EXACT target (ppc_evaluated=true).
